categories.main_business_segments: EXEO Group operates three main business segments: Engineering Solutions (including telecommunications infrastructure for carriers and urban infrastructure such as electrical, civil, and environmental engineering), System Solutions (system integration, network integration, and IT services for various industries), and Global Business (mainly IT and infrastructure solutions in Southeast Asia and other regions).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced engineering and construction technologies for telecommunications and urban infrastructure, as well as IT system integration capabilities. It emphasizes safety and quality management, utilizes digital transformation (DX), AI, cloud, and network technologies, and applies multi-skilled and reskilled technical personnel. R&D focuses on automation, efficiency, and new business models, including the use of generative AI and renewable energy technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major telecommunications carriers (notably the NTT Group), public sector entities (municipalities, government agencies), CATV and railway companies, and private enterprises across finance, manufacturing, and education. The company also serves data centers, renewable energy operators, and global clients in Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: EXEO Group's primary operations are in Japan, with significant business in Asia, especially Southeast Asia (Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam, Philippines, etc.). The majority of revenue is generated in Japan, but overseas business, particularly in IT and infrastructure, is expanding.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly as a midstream and downstream player, providing engineering, construction, and integration services that connect upstream equipment/material suppliers with end customers. It delivers turnkey solutions from design and construction to maintenance and operation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening core engineering and IT capabilities, expanding high-value-added and consulting-driven solutions, promoting digital transformation, and advancing sustainability (ESG, carbon neutrality, renewable energy). R&D is directed at automation, AI, cloud, and smart infrastructure, with a focus on new business models and global expansion.
categories.revenue_model: EXEO Group generates revenue primarily through project-based sales (engineering, construction, and system integration contracts), maintenance and operation services, and, to a lesser extent, product sales and licensing. Recurring revenue streams include maintenance contracts and managed services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other large Japanese engineering and system integration firms such as Nippon COMSYS, Kandenko, and Kyowa Exeo's traditional rivals in telecom and urban infrastructure. EXEO Group is a top-tier player in telecom engineering and is strengthening its position in IT solutions and global markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales reached 670.8 billion yen (approx. $4.2 billion), with operating profit of 42.5 billion yen and net income attributable to parent of 26.9 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth, achieving its mid-term sales targets ahead of schedule, and continues to expand both domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EXEO Group differentiates itself through its ability to deliver integrated, end-to-end engineering and IT solutions, leveraging deep technical expertise, a strong track record with major carriers and public sector clients, and a commitment to safety, quality, and sustainability. Its focus on digital transformation, ESG, and global expansion further enhances its value proposition.
